notes.title: Once Upon A KATAMARI - Announcement Trailer
notes.content:
Time travel across eras and restore the stars in Once Upon A KATAMARI 🌈


Experience a fabulous new soundtrack, cousin customization, and 4 player KatamariBall mode!


This will be a Katamari experience for the ages!   [previewyoutube="JQpojKTAvPY;full"][/previewyoutube]Coming October 24, 2025   [dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1880620/Once_Upon_A_KATAMARI/"][/dynamiclink]
